title: Origins of the Mesoamerican ballgame
summary: An earthen ball court at Paso de la Amada, in the Soconusco region of Pacific coastal Chiapas, Mexico, is the oldest known Mesoamerican ballcourt. Nature dated it to about 1400 BC (uncalibrated), while a Brigham Young University magazine places its construction about 1600 B.C. and describes an 80-metre alley with raised bleachers.

uncertainty.note: Sources give about 1600 B.C. (BYU) and about 1400 BC uncalibrated (Nature, Sky HISTORY); the span covers both.
